'''Arts and culture'''
*[[75th Tony Awards]]
**At this year's [[Tony Awards]], ''[[A Strange Loop]]'' wins [[Tony Award for Best Musical|Best Musical]] while ''[[The Lehman Trilogy]]'' wins [[Tony Award for Best Play|Best Play]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2022/06/12/theater/tony-awards (''New York Times'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Boycott of Russia and Belarus]]
**Three months after [[McDonald's]] suspended its operations in [[Russia]] and sold its 850 restaurants to Alexander Govor, the [[rebranding|rebranded]] restaurants are reopened as [[Vkusno i tochka]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-moscow-restaurants-39892c3a0a8121ae2bbfd11478c32ae0 (AP)]
*The [[Celsius Network]] [[cryptocurrency]] [[Cryptocurrency exchange|lending platform]] announced it was "pausing all withdrawals, swap, and transfers between accounts" amidst a large pullback in the cryptocurrency market. [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/06/13/crypto-lender-celsius-pauses-withdrawals-bitcoin-slides.html (CNBC)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Authorities in [[Argentina]] seize an [[Iran]]ian [[Boeing 747]] which was transferred to [[Venezuela]] last year. It is unclear if the impound is related to [[Economic sanctions|sanctions]] that have been imposed on both countries. [https://www.reuters.com/world/iranian-state-controlled-media-say-mahan-air-aircraft-seized-argentina-no-2022-06-12/ (Reuters)]
*At least 30 members of the American [[Neo-fascism|neo-fascist]] group [[Patriot Front]] are arrested for conspiracy to [[riot]] at a [[Pride parade|pride event]] in [[Coeur d'Alene, Idaho]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/coeur-dalene-idaho-government-and-politics-arrests-01fd15f6d3b3bcab9404106c85f673c3 (AP)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 French legislative election]]
**Voters in [[France]] go to the [[Polling place|polls]] to elect the first round of the 577 [[Deputy (France)|members]] of the 16th National Assembly. [https://apnews.com/article/macron-france-business-presidential-elections-1d135bcaf3cd569268434fd24f33cdd7 (AP)]
**Exit polls show [[New Ecologic and Social People's Union|the coalition of left-wing parties]] headed by far-left [[Deputy (France)|deputy]] [[Jean-Luc Mélenchon]] barely edging out [[President of France|President]] [[Emmanuel Macron]]'s coalition [[Ensemble Citoyens]] for the most votes in the first round, winning 25.6% and 25.2% of the votes respectively. Overall turnout is projected to be 47%, the lowest recorded for a French election. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/jun/12/emmanuel-macrons-coalition-level-with-new-leftwing-group-in-french-elections (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2022 Italian referendum]]
**The [[referendum]] for the reform of the [[Judiciary of Italy|judicial system]] is invalidated as it did not reach the required 50% threshold. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/referendum-flop-italys-salvini-right-eyes-local-gains-2022-06-13/ (Reuters)] 

'''Sports'''
*[[2022 European Tour]]
**In [[golf]], [[Linn Grant]] of Sweden becomes the first female winner on the [[PGA European Tour]] following her win in the [[Scandinavian Masters|Scandinavian Mixed]]. The tournament was co-sanctioned with the [[Ladies European Tour]] in 2020. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/06/13/golf/linn-grant-win-dp-world-tour-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
